_comments.password: Real secret goes in neo4j.config.json (gitignored). Env NEO4J_PASSWORD overrides.
_comments.sandbox: Absolute path to the Neo4j Singularity sandbox (built once, cluster-specific).
_comments.data_dir: Empty = <repo_root>/neo4j (data stays inside the project, read-only KB after populate).
_comments.*_port_range: neo4j_up.sh picks the first FREE port in each range on node 0.
_comments.heap_max/pagecache: Neo4j JVM heap and page cache sizing.
